PraisonAIUI exposes an AG-UI SSE endpoint (POST /agui) so CopilotKit and any AG-UI-compatible frontend can stream runs directly from your PraisonAI agents.

The AG-UI encoder and runner come from praisonaiagents: When praisonaiagents is not installed (or no agent is available), POST /agui returns HTTP 503 and GET /agui/status reports "status": "unavailable".

Register an agent in your app.py (or configure one via the Agents page or PraisonAI gateway): POST /agui resolves the target agent in this order: Explicitly registered agents (aiui.register_agent(name, agent)) matching agent_name in the JSON body or ?agent= query parameter (falls back to the registered agent when omitted). Active AIUIGateway agents when running with --backend praisonai. Existing provider agents, or lazily constructed agents from the Agents CRUD store when praisonaiagents is installed.

Method Path Description POST /agui Stream an AG-UI run (text/event-stream). Validates the body as RunAgentInput (400 on invalid payload, 503 when no agent or praisonaiagents is available). OPTIONS /agui CORS preflight for browser AG-UI clients. GET /agui/status Check availability: {"status": "available" \ "unavailable", "agent_registered": bool}.
Select a specific agent with "agent_name": "researcher" in the JSON body or ?agent=researcher on the URL.
